flagged.title: The Red Guards and the Red Terror, 1966-68
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly claims that Liu Shaoqi was publicly paraded in a dunce cap at a university rally (which was actually his wife Wang Guangmei at Tsinghua University), causing students to fail lesson checks on the leadership purges.

mark_affecting.quote: The president himself, Liu Shaoqi, was publicly paraded in a dunce cap at a university rally.
